output:
## Draft reply

Hello Ada,

Thank you for your note. I'm glad to hear from you about your necklace with the new clasp.

To collect it, please book the 10-minute Pick up appointment here:
https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=16919152

I work by appointment only, so booking a time that suits you is the best way to arrange it. The showroom is at The Winslow Showroom at Harbor Square, 752 Winslow Way East, Bainbridge Island.

If anything doesn't work with the booking page, call me at 206-605-1510 or reply here.

Warmly,
Alina

## Intake note for Alina

- **Reported issue:** Ada says you emailed yesterday that her necklace, with the new clasp, is ready. She wants to book a collection time.
- **Not known yet:** Order or drop-off details. I can't see your records or that email.
- **Decisions for you:** Please check that the necklace is ready and that you did send that email. I didn't confirm either in the reply.
- **Suggested appointment:** Pick up (10 minutes), because Ada says you have already told her it's ready.
